```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
rm(list=ls())
library(here)
library(tidyverse)  
library(ape)
library(brms)
library(rstan)
library(cmdstanr)
```

# 1. Load dataset
```{r}
spe_tax_phylo_BM_FFG_sensi_subCAS <- readRDS(here("data/6_combined/spe_tax_phylo_BM_FFG_sensi_subCAS.rds"))

phylo_tree <- readRDS(here("data/6_combined/phylo_tree.rds"))
```

# 2. Prepare data for Bayesian analysis
```{r}
dat <- spe_tax_phylo_BM_FFG_sensi_subCAS %>%
  transmute(
    log_sensi = log_sensi,
    log_rel_sensi = log_rel_sensi,   
    log_mass  = log_mass,
    log_mass_c  = log_mass_c,
    group = factor(group),
    FG = factor(FG5),
    chem_group = factor(chem_group),
    duration  =  duration,
    CAS       =  as.character(CAS),
    latin     =  latin
  ) %>%
  filter(duration == "24")    %>%
  mutate(phylo = latin) 

splist <- unique(dat$latin)
tree_sub <- keep.tip(phylo_tree, intersect(phylo_tree$tip.label, splist))
tree_A <- ape::vcv.phylo(tree_sub, corr = TRUE)

dat$phylo <- factor(dat$phylo, levels = rownames(tree_A))
```

# 3. Run four Bayesian models for each chemical group

Prepare sub-dataset for a specific chemical group
```{r}
CG <- unique(dat$chem_group)
chem_target <- CG[1]  # change index to run for different chemical groups

dat_sub <- dat %>%
  filter(chem_group == chem_target) %>% 
  mutate(FG = relevel(factor(FG), ref = "Cyanobacteria")) 
ref_FG <- levels(dat_sub$FG)[1]
```

Bayesian models are:

-   M1 (global allometry): We built the baseline model to test whether a
    single mass–sensitivity slope applies across all functional groups:
    `relative sensitivity ∼ mass + (phylogeny)`.

-   M2 (group baseline) We tested whether baseline sensitivity differs
    among functional groups (FG):
    `relative sensitivity ∼ mass + FG + (phylogeny)`.

-   M3 (group allometry): We further tested whether mass-sensitivity
    slopes differ among functional groups:
    `relative sensitivity ∼ mass × FG + (phylogeny)`.

-   M4 (without phylogeny): We fitted the same fixed effects without
    phylogenetic control to gauge the impact of ignoring shared
    ancestry: `relative sensitivity ∼ mass × FG`.

Bayesian model settings:
```{r}
pri <- c( 
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "Intercept"), 
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "b"), 
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sigma"),
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sd")
)
pri2 <- c( # for M4
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "b"),
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 1), class = "sigma"))

thr <- threading(threads = 20)    # run in HPC
Sys.setenv(STAN_NUM_THREADS = 20) # run in HPC

chain <- 2
cor <- 2
ite <- 6000
warm <- 3000

out_dir <- here("model_output", "bayesian_models")
```


## M1: baseline phylo (common slope; no FG) ----
```{r eval=FALSE}
# sensitivity ~ mass + (1 | phylogeny)
fit_M1 <- brm(
  log_rel_sensi ~ log_mass_c + (1 | gr(phylo, cov = tree_A)),
  data = dat_sub, data2 = list(tree_A = tree_A),
  family = gaussian(), prior = pri,
  backend = "cmdstanr", chains = chain, cores = cor, 
  threads = thr, seed = 1007,
  iter = ite, warmup = warm, 
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95, max_treedepth = 12))

fit_file_name <- paste0(out_dir, "/fit_M1_", chem_target, ".rds")
saveRDS(fit_M1, here(fit_file_name))
```


## M2: intercepts (FG main effects; common slope)
```{r eval=FALSE}
# sensitivity ~ mass + FG + (1 | phylogeny)
fit_M2 <- brm(
  log_rel_sensi ~ log_mass_c + FG + (1 | gr(phylo, cov = tree_A)),
  data = dat_sub, data2 = list(tree_A = tree_A),
  family = gaussian(), prior = pri,
  threads = thr, seed = 1007,
  iter = ite, warmup = warm, 
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95, max_treedepth = 12))

fit_file_name <- paste0(out_dir, "/fit_M2_", chem_target, ".rds")
saveRDS(fit_M2, here(fit_file_name))
```


## M3: slopes (group allometry; FG × mass)
```{r eval=FALSE}
# sensitivity ~ mass * FG + (1 | phylogeny)
fit_M3 <- brm(
  log_rel_sensi ~ log_mass_c * FG + (1 | gr(phylo, cov = tree_A)),
  data = dat_sub, data2 = list(tree_A = tree_A),
  family = gaussian(), prior = pri,
  threads = thr, seed = 1007,
  iter = ite, warmup = warm, 
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95, max_treedepth = 12))
summary(fit_M3)

fit_file_name <- paste0(out_dir, "/fit_M3_", chem_target, ".rds")
saveRDS(fit_M3, here(fit_file_name))
```


## M4: no phylogeny
```{r eval=FALSE}
# sensitivity ~ mass * FG
fit_M4 <- brm(
  log_rel_sensi ~ log_mass_c * FG,
  data = dat_sub,
  family = gaussian(), prior = pri2,
  threads = thr, seed = 1007,
  iter = ite, warmup = warm, 
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95, max_treedepth = 12))

fit_file_name <- paste0(out_dir, "/fit_M4_", chem_target, ".rds")
saveRDS(fit_M4, here(fit_file_name))
```
